text: INTERPRETER per-frame Kernel: the handle-addressed kernel tables (provenance stores, corrigibility latch, current principal, goal constraint, principals, scheduler, supervisors, stores, LLM gateways, kernel goals, sandboxes, active sandbox) move into a Kernel struct, kernels: [Kernel; 2] selected by k() from frame_sealed, so a sealed frame reaches only its own (the sealed registry draws tokens from TOKEN_DOMAIN_SEALED). Every RNG draw and reseed goes through Interp::rng_next/rng_reseed, refused for operator code above a sealed frame; the sealed kernel has its own stream seeded by a SHA-256 derivation, the operator kernel keeps main's process-global stream (unsealed sequence pinned bit-identical). sandbox_run copies the entered ceiling into the sealed kernel for the call. frame_sealed is never set in an unsealed run, so it reaches kernels[0] only; no seal edge enters a sealed frame yet; not PCI-reviewed; every sealed run is still refused (SEAL_RUNTIME_COMPLETE = false)
